meta.title: MarkX — compare prices, buy from trusted shops
meta.description: Compare phone and electronics prices from verified Addis Ababa shops. See the total to your door and pay after you inspect.

search.label: Search products
search.tryAgain: Check the spelling, try fewer words, or browse a category.
search.requestTitle: Can't find it? Ask for it
search.requestBody: Tell us what you are looking for. Our catalogue team reads every request.
search.requestPhone: Your phone, if you want an answer (optional)
search.requestSent: Thank you. Your request was sent.
search.requestFailed: We could not send that. Check the phone number and try again.

home.heading: Compare prices from trusted shops
home.lead: One product, every shop's price, with delivery to your door added in.
home.protection1: Every shop is checked by MarkX before it can sell.
home.protection2: See the total with delivery before you order.
home.protection3: Pay after you inspect, and give your code only when the goods are right.

product.noOffers: No shop offers this version right now.
product.zoneAny: Choose your area to see delivery
product.addFailed: That offer could not be added. Refresh and try again.
product.inspect: Pay after you inspect. Give your handover code only when the goods are right.

footer.about: MarkX compares prices from verified shops in Addis Ababa. MarkX never holds your money.

errors.notFound: We could not find that page.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.lead: Use your phone number. We send you a six-digit code; no password needed.
auth.codeSent: We sent a code to {phone}. It is valid for {minutes} minutes.
auth.failed: That did not work. Check the number or the code and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
auth.devHint: Development build: codes are written to the local SMS inbox, not sent.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.changesNotice: Some prices changed since you added them.
cart.problem_out_of_stock: Not enough in stock any more.
cart.problem_unavailable: This offer is no longer available.
cart.problemGeneric: This item cannot be ordered right now.
cart.failed: We could not load your cart. Please try again.
cart.perSeller: Each shop delivers its own part of your order.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.payNote: You pay the shop directly when you receive and inspect the goods. MarkX never holds your money.
checkout.totalChanged: A price or fee changed. Review the new total and try again.
checkout.next: What happens next: each shop confirms its part, usually within 30 minutes in business hours. You will see their phone number once they confirm.

orders.title: Your orders
orders.trackingHint: Anyone with this link can follow the order, but cannot see your code or your address details.
orders.handoverWarning: Give this code only after you have inspected the goods and they are right. MarkX will never ask you for it.
orders.problemSent: Your report was sent. MarkX staff will decide within 48 hours.
orders.actionFailed: That did not work. Refresh the page and try again.

decision.no_action: No refund; the order is completed

store.noOffers: This shop has no offers right now.
